notes.title: Free prologue with new boss and secret mission!
notes.content:
Greetings!

We are excited to present the new and mysterious free game Union of Gnomes: Prologue.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2960560/Union_of_Gnomes_Prologue/

It combines the creepy atmosphere of dark fantasy, cheerful humor, and, of course, the daring gnomes desperately fighting for their freedom and independence. 
 
[previewyoutube=atZ26XQlAEQ;full][/previewyoutube]

Lead a motley crew of guerrillas to free your captured comrades and escape the tyranny of the ruthless Snow White. For the tenacious players, we've hidden a secret quest within the prologue—conquering it will bring you closer to solving the mystery of the eighth gnome! Look for the clue in the video!

Here's what you'll find in the game:

 One new, unique and terribly dangerous mission!
 A dangerous new boss!
 A secret quest!
 A lot of well-known – and not so well-known – fairy tale characters who fight on the side of evil, trying to suppress and destroy the gnomes!
 Create unusual combos with your gnome cards to reach the end of the prologue or die with honor!

Once you've finished the prologue (and added Union of Gnomes to your Steam Wishlist), you can look forward to the full story of the gnomes' heroic adventures as they fight for their freedom in the full game. The gnomes stand for freedom and the right not to impose subjugation on anyone else!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2097030/Union_of_Gnomes/ 

Don't forget to recommend the game to your friends and favorite streamers, share your impressions, and leave a review. 

Freedom to Gnomes!
Union of Gnomes Team

notes.title: Marble Duel - New Update is here!
notes.content:
Good news for all Marble Duel players!

The magical forest is restless. Upcoming changes will affect the brave heroes that have already started their adventure and those that are still at the beginning of their journey.

 Additional levels (after lv. 119) have returned! If you’ve missed playing these levels, get the update and enjoy yourselves ;)
 Added Steam cloud synchronization. Now you can play from multiple computers and keep your progress.
 As Glinda the Good Witch says in The Wizard of Oz, "It's always best to start at the beginning". Therefore, we have added an option to reset progress.

That's all for now, but the game continues to develop and improve. Thank you for staying with us;)

notes.title: Marble Duel - New Update is here!
notes.content:
What's new:


    Levels on first map have been re-balanced.
    Upgrades window has been re-designed.

Minor fixes and stability improvements.

notes.title: Marble Duel - Windows update
notes.content:
Evy faced with the intrigues of the witch and her servants once more.

Evy's witching abilities and your skill will help you to win this battle.

Fight with the monsters in the new levels and destroy every one of them.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/338120/Marble_Duel/

Also, look forward to:
A new, never-before-seen monster - the Cave Worm
15 new levels
Living map - meet the dwellers of the land of forests and lakes
100% gamepad support


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10776056/09ba22e3817edb26e68c093e27d79362118c428f.gif

Thanks! We wish you victory in battle!
